title: Complementing decision tree inputs
statement: Let a decision tree on $n$ binary coordinates, with values in a type $\alpha$, query only coordinates in an available set. Complementing its inputs leaves each leaf value unchanged and, at every query, exchanges the two child subtrees while retaining the queried coordinate and the available set.
hypotheses_covered: A decision tree indexed by an available subset of coordinates
